## Summary

Describe the user-visible or operational change.

## Data and provider impact

- [ ] No provider or schema change
- [ ] Jolpica / OpenF1 / FastF1 / RSS behavior changed
- [ ] Database migration added or updated

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `pytest -q` from `services/ingest/` when worker code changed

## UI evidence

For UI changes, attach desktop and mobile screenshots and describe any accessibility impact.
